name: NOODLE BAR INTERIOR
text: The cramped quarters smell of star-anise and
hot metal. The warm glow of the burners and
string lights fights a losing battle against
the industrial grey of the walls.

text: Scuffed and stained from years of spilled
broth and hasty knife work. Three large pots

sending plumes of fragrant steam toward the

name: LONG CUSTOMER BAR
text: A heavy, utilitarian counter facing the
kitchen area. The surface is marred by
countless hasty meals and spilled drinks, a
testament to the ebb and flow of hungry

name: PANTRY SHELVING UNIT
text: Sturdy metal shelves crammed with neatly
stacked ceramic bowls, battered cooking pots,
and an assortment of worn spice tins. A
testament to organized chaos in a confined

name: FLOOR PIPING CONDUIT
text: Thick, reinforced pipes run along the
baseboard, likely carrying coolant or heating
fluid for the station's temperamental life
support systems. The paint is flaking off in

name: COMPACT KITCHEN SINK
text: A deep basin set into a scarred metal counter,
piled high with dirty noodle bowls waiting for
attention. A stained cloth rests nearby on the
grating.

name: LUCKY CAT SHRINE
text: A small wooden alcove houses a ceramic Maneki-
neko, its paw raised in perpetual invitation.
Flanked by flickering electronic candles and
small offerings, it brings a touch of old-

name: FOLDING WOODEN TABLE
text: A narrow, scuffed table pushed against the
wall, likely used for overflow seating or
hastily unpacking supplies. A single forgotten
slip of paper rests on its surface.

name: HANGING COOKWARE RACK
text: A simple metal bar bolted to the wall holds an
assortment of dented pans and long-handled
ladles. They clink softly in the draft from
the nearby ventilation unit.

name: ATMOSPHERIC PROCESSOR UNIT
text: A bulky, humming machine tucked into the
corner, its fan slowly circulating the heavy,
scent-laden air. Rust blooms around its edges,
hinting at years of constant use.

name: EXPOSED WALL WIRING
text: Thick, rubberized cables snake haphazardly out
from beneath the counter, connecting the
kitchen equipment to the station's erratic
power grid.

name: TALL REFRIGERATOR UNIT
text: A heavy, industrial fridge, its surface dinged
and adorned with a few fading, handwritten
notes. The hum of its compressor is a constant
undercurrent to the bubbling pots.

name: LARGE SOUP POT
text: A battered aluminum stockpot sits on a roaring
gas burner, its contents hidden beneath a
slightly askew lid. The heat radiating from it
is palpable, even from a distance.
